propositions: A cancelled or timed-out mutation job casts Verified -1 with message 'CANCELLED: <url>' that carries no job name, duration, or reason, requiring manual triage by opening the run and reading job conclusions.
The gerrit-review-action has no input for custom message text and hardcodes 'STATUS: URL' format; comment-only input only suppresses labels, not the message itself.
A new summarize_ci_failures.py script maps job list payloads plus check-run annotations to one line per non-successful job with name, outcome (TIMED OUT/CANCELLED/FAILED), duration, and URL.
An SSH gerrit review --message step posts triage detail as a comment (no --label) to the change, guarded on vote-type not being success, after the vote is already cast.
Job names and matrix shard names derived from patchset-controlled configuration require escaping of single quotes, backslashes, and control characters to prevent command injection over SSH.
The mechanism distinguishes timeout (annotation says 'exceeded maximum execution time') from failure and cancellation, providing triagers actionable signal about whether a rebase or re-run is needed.
